LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 13.3.1 SENTENCES: COMPLEX SENTENCES

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 13
Topic 13.3: Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Sentences: Complex Sentences

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Sentences: Complex Sentences. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: What is the role of conjunctions in sentences?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify subordinating conjunctions in sentences
2. construct complex sentences using subordinating conjunctions learnt

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: GRAMMAR IN USE 13.3.1 SENTENCES: COMPLEX SENTENCES
This lesson teaches Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Sentences: Complex Sentences for Grade 9 ENGLISH.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify subordinating conjunctions in sentences
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. construct complex sentences using subordinating conjunctions learnt
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Sentences: Complex Sentences using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Sentences: Complex Sentences above.
2. Explain Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Sentences: Complex Sentences to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Sentences: Complex Sentences.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Sentences: Complex Sentences with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Sentences: Complex Sentences important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What is the role of conjunctions in sentences?
2. How can one differentiate between a simple and a complex sentence?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify subordinating conjunctions in sentences
2. construct complex sentences using subordinating conjunctions learnt

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
